mapper.sql: SELECT posts.id, posts.user_id, users.username, posts.body, posts.image_url, posts.created_at, posts.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM likes WHERE likes.post_id = posts.id) AS like_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE comments.post_id = posts.id) AS comment_count, EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM likes WHERE likes.post_id = posts.id AND likes.user_id = #{currentUserId} ) AS liked_by_current_user FROM posts JOIN users ON posts.user_id = users.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO posts (user_id, body, image_url) VALUES (#{userId}, #{body}, #{imageUrl})
mapper.select: WHERE posts.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY posts.created_at DESC
